items.title: MARU matcha pop-up at Wishing Cup

items.title: Caribe & Co. pop-up cafe at SoWa Christmas Market
menu: carrot punch matcha (cold brew or matcha)
items.description: A Caribbean-inspired pop-up cafe inside the SoWa Christmas Market, serving cornmeal porridge matcha lattes and a carrot punch that can be made with matcha all holiday season.
items.notes: Season run Nov 20 - Dec 27 and hours (Sat 10am-10pm, Christmas Eve 10am-4pm) quoted in Caribe & Co. captions via search snippets; page not opened. Matcha is one drink among coffees. Extra date beyond the Saturdays already on map.
